title: eludite.git.branches input
description: The branches and tags (Git > Manage Branches: the Git Repository window), each local branch with its upstream and the outgoing and incoming counts; or `delete` a local branch (the Git Repository window's Delete). A branch not merged into HEAD is deleted only with `force`, which is refused for agents. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: `delete` is class execute; `force` is refused for agents outright.

force.description: Delete a branch that is not merged. Refused for agents.

remote.description: List remote branches too. Default true.
